title: Load staged-but-unloaded store-level sell-through
acceptance_criteria: The customers that have store or site level rows staged and not loaded are discovered from the data (staged rows against loaded rows, by customer and job), not assumed
For each such customer: the jobs that hold the staged rows, their status and stage, what stops each from loading, row and unit counts and date range are recorded
Loading follows the repo rules: oldest file first, validate then apply, clone proof first, then a 'run against cip' gate from Warren; each job's load report matches the clone proof
No master is auto-created; unmatched products and stores go to the steward
